subject: Amendment: zipper phasing for renewal + capacity upsell
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@cloudify.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>; marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@cloudify.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion: aligning year boundaries & capacity increase

Hi Sergio / Marissa,

Thanks again for the recent performance review — latency has been great and the team is pleased. As we approach our renewal window (mid-December), Cloudify is looking to:

- Increase committed spend by ~35% to cover new feature rollout next Q1
- Move to a co-term setup so our multiple contracts end on 2028-12-31
- Prefer a staged delivery (we called it "zipper" internally) where additional capacity comes online in 3 phases across Q1–Q3 to avoid heavy upfront OPEX.

Attached is our current usage export (current-usage.csv) and a short calendar of our product launch dates. Can your team sketch feasible term structures and any pricing/credit mechanics for phased upsells? Also looping procurement on this thread — Jordan will help with PO timelines.

Appreciate a quick sketch by next week so we can sync with Finance.

Best,
Emily Chen
Director of Platform Engineering
Cloudify Inc.

-----

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@cloudify.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: aligning year boundaries & capacity increase

Emily — thanks for the clear ask. Quick proposal below (high level):

1) Zipper phasing (3 phases, co-term to 2028-12-31):
   - Phase A (start 2028-01-01): +15% committed capacity (immediate activation)
   - Phase B (start 2028-04-01): +10% committed capacity (auto-apply unless opt-out)
   - Phase C (start 2028-07-01): +10% committed capacity (final reconciliation at renewal)

2) Pricing mechanics:
   - Phase A billed as add-on to current invoice, eligible for 5% prepay discount if paid upfront for first 6 months
   - Phases B/C will have a rollover credit if actual usage < committed for that phase (to avoid overpay risk)

3) Auto-renew / co-term: we can co-term to 2028-12-31 with an annual true-up and an opt-out window 60 days before year-end.

Next steps:
- I'll drop a zipper-phasing-sheet.xlsx with a sample amortized cashflow and token-band estimate.
- Marissa to flag any pricing exceptions / credit bands.
- Karthik to confirm legal language for auto-apply phase B opt-out.

If this is directionally good, we can produce a draft amendment and route it for signature.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily@cloudify.com>; karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: aligning year boundaries & capacity increase

Sergio / Emily — attaching a draft amendment (redwood-amendment-draft-v1.pdf) with two pricing options:

A) Staged Billing (default)\   - Phase A billed monthly as usage accrues, Phase B/C only billed when phased in\   - No prepay discount

B) Frontloaded Credit (preferred if Cloudify wants lower unit price)\   - 6-month prepay across Phase A & partial B for 6% discount on committed units\   - Excess usage billed at overage rates; unused committed units convert to a credit applied at renewal

Notes: we kept the auto-apply for Phase B as a default but added an explicit opt-out form that Procurement can sign if they don't want automatic expansion. If procurement prefers active approval we can flip to opt-in.

I also included a sample amortization table in zipper-phasing-sheet.xlsx and a one-pager that summarizes cost delta.

-Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Opers — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-amendment-draft-v1.pdf (pdf, 320KB)
Attachment: zipper-phasing-sheet.xlsx (sheet, 48KB)

Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 16:22:00 -0800

Quick legal/ops confirmations:

- Auto-apply Phase B: we will keep it as a default but require Procurement to sign the opt-out form at least 14 days prior to Phase B start (2028-03-17 cutoff).
- SLA footprint: for increased committed units we can offer the same latency SLA; any additional credits for missed SLOs remain per the existing SLA schedule.
- Data residency / private deploy note: nothing in this amendment changes data handling; if Cloudify wants Dedicated capacity for isolated workloads that can be scoped separately.

Action items:
- Sergio to send final amendment with fillable opt-out checkbox and a short PO template.
- Marissa to confirm invoice cadence options (monthly vs quarterly billing for Phase A).

Related links: HubSpot DEAL-457 for tracking; I will add the redlined contract to the legal drive.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Sergio / Team — this looks good and aligns with our internal launch rhythm. We are comfortable with the zipper phasing as proposed (Phase A +15% effective 2028-01-01; auto-apply Phase B with opt-out by 2028-03-17; Phase C reconciliation at renewal).

Procurement (cc) — please use the attached PO template (Procurement, can you confirm lead time for PO and the invoicing cadence you prefer?). If everything looks right we'll sign the amendment when you send the fillable copy.

One operational ask: can Redwood include an estimated token-band and expected monthly cost for Phase A in the amendment so our Finance team can include the uplift in the Dec forecast? If Marissa can add a one-line estimate we can route quickly.

Thanks — Emily
